items.detail: SIS names are semantically inverted in renderer: kerning supplies texture bytes, textures supplies metric bytes. Preserve declarations pending independent family review.
Reverse scan reads x6C; exact capacity fill lacks spare sentinel. Growth and indices truncate to u16; malformed stacks/unaligned payload reads not validated.
Only x78.x restored; type1 restore can change x78.y. Stack length reset does not restore overwritten lower records or allocation. Width subtracts unscaled trailing spacing.

Fitted horizontal UV clipping uses unfitted denominator. Custom glyphs lack required data in direct mode. No stream/glyph bound or cyclic-jump guard. MUST_MATCH matrix stack offsets not runtime validated.

asset.inspection: Hashed only; no glyph artwork or generated byte source review claimed.
